name: benchmark
short: Measure native Local speed with fixed prompts

flags.name: model
flags.usage: Must be local; no other route is used

flags.name: quiet
flags.usage: Hide notes, hints and progress on stderr; never hide errors or the answer

flags.name: select
flags.usage: Comma-separated fields to include in JSON output (e.g. --select response)

side_effects: invokes only native Local with fixed built-in prompts: one first call plus four serial cases times --runs (1-20, default 5); one case counts tokens without generation
runs read-only platform, hardware, load and native availability/protocol checks; ignores saved defaults and model environment variables
does not read user prompts, write conversation state, use Shortcuts, attach tools or make network requests; Ctrl-C prints partial measurements and exits 130
